**Reasoning**

- Each person eats \(0.2\) kg of rice per meal.  
- There are 5 people, and they eat rice at lunch and dinner → 2 meals per day.  

Daily consumption:
\[
5 \text{ people} \times 0.2\ \text{kg/meal} \times 2\ \text{meals/day}=2\ \text{kg/day}
\]

A 42 kg bag will last:
\[
\frac{42\ \text{kg}}{2\ \text{kg/day}} = 21\ \text{days}
\]

Convert days to weeks:
\[
\frac{21\ \text{days}}{7\ \text{days/week}} = 3\ \text{weeks}
\]

**Final answer:**  
Final answer: 3
